items.prompt: Your friend has just moved to Canada and wants to find a job quickly. Give your friend advice about how to find work.
Your coworker feels stressed because they have too much work and never finish on time. Give your coworker advice about managing their workload.
Your neighbour wants to start exercising but has never been very active. Give your neighbour advice about how to begin.
Your cousin wants to save enough money to buy a car next year. Give your cousin advice about how to save.
Your friend has a job interview next week and feels very nervous about it. Give your friend advice about how to prepare.
A family member wants to eat more healthily but says they do not know how to cook. Give them advice.
Your friend spends hours on their phone every night and is not sleeping well. Give your friend advice.
Your younger brother is finishing high school and cannot decide what to study at college. Give him advice about making the decision.
Your friend is about to spend their first winter in Canada. Give your friend advice about preparing for the cold weather.
Your colleague wants to improve their English speaking skills but has little free time. Give your colleague advice.
